description: This file defines a React component named UsersSummaryCards which renders a set of KPI summary cards with loading and empty state fallbacks. It includes a nested CardStat component for rendering individual cards, and specifies types for component props.

methods.name: CardStat
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a single KPI card with a label and value, supporting loading state and custom colors.

methods.name: UsersSummaryCards
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a grid of KPI summary cards based on provided items and loading state.
